WITH ss AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_quantity, ss_list_price, ss_coupon_amt, ss_sales_price
  FROM store_sales
),
cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_gender = 'M' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
),
d AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999
),
st AS (
  SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
  FROM store
  WHERE s_state = 'TN'
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, st.s_state, grouping(st.s_state) AS g_state,
       avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM ss
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((i.i_item_id, st.s_state), (i.i_item_id), ())
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
